basic_info.description: This charming 1920s bungalow has been carefully crafted, updated and beautifully landscaped by well-reknown bay area designers.Set on a large Sunnyside lot with views of the surrounding hills, this is a bright and airy 3 bedroom home with large windows, designer lighting, gleaming hardwoods, and plenty of storage. The light, open floor plan features a spacious kitchen and sunny living/dining room with direct access to the oversized rear yard - and what a yard it is! A large deck becomes a protected second living room to the home with plentiful lounging and entertaining space overlooking the tall fescue lawn and a vast variety of plants. A sharp, modern office - heated, and featuring designer lighting - sits like a jewel cushioned by a lush garden. At the rear of the yard the generous stone patio offers al fresco dining for 8+. With a custom workbench in the garage, a french cleat storage system, Tesla car charger, and elevated storage this is a gardener and woodworker's dream home. Move in ready, this home has been polished to perfection. An easy walk to BART, shops, and restaurants.
